claim: Phenotype conditioning is evaluated on exact-coordinate post-2023 solved cases after choosing every mixing weight on older held-out cases.

design.molecular_condition: Gene-history inputs are neutralized for every model.
design.phenotype_similarity: Ontology-aware symmetric Resnik similarity against older cases of each candidate gene; the best-matching older case is used.
design.weight_selection: Beta and the missing-gene phenotype prior are selected separately for each model on older cases containing both familiar and completely held-out genes. The post-2023 cases are never used for tuning.
design.candidate_design: One causal hypothesis plus nine temporally new benign ClinVar hypotheses per case.

limitations: This is a compact patient-level candidate benchmark, not a full-exome rerun for every external patient.
Candidate decoys come from ClinVar rather than each patient's own sequencing file.
Phenotype matching can help only when older reference cases exist for the candidate gene; seen and unseen causal genes are reported separately.
The HPO layer is case-based and deterministic. The learned molecular rankers remain unchanged.
